## Research Opportunities

Currently seeking research assistant opportunities and preparing applications for PhD programmes beginning in Fall 2027, particularly in high-skilled mobility, scientific collaboration networks, urban and regional innovation, and related quantitative research. The next stage of training is intended to deepen theoretical and methodological foundations while developing a sustained empirical research agenda around mobility, scientific relationships, and innovation. Enquiries about RA positions, PhD supervision, and related research collaboration are welcome.
